title: Where not to find the spectrum of the partial theta function
summary: The spectrum of Ramanujan's partial theta function $θ(q,x):=\sum _{j=0}^{\infty}q^{j(j+1)/2}x^j$, $q\in \mathbb{D}_1$ (the unit disk centered at the origin), $x\in \mathbb{C}$, is the set of values of the parameter $q$ for which $θ(q,.)$ has a multiple zero. We show that there is no spectral value in the set $\mathbb{S}\cup \mathbb{D}_{c_0}$, $c_0=0.2078750206\ldots$, where $\mathbb{S}$ is the sector $\{ 0<|z|<0.6,{\rm arg}(z)\in [π/4 ,7π/4 ]\}$.
